exposure: gestational weight gain (GWG) as per Institute of Medicine 2009 (IOM)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with either gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) or preexisting diabetes mellitus (PDM) attended at the study's center.
finding: In women with preexisting diabetes mellitus, correcting gestational weight gain for gestational age significantly modified the associations with various clinical outcomes, whereas this correction had little impact on associations in women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: In women with GDM, gestational age correction did not affect the association with cesarean delivery, while in women with PDM, IOM-GWG was significantly associated with cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: N/A (though outcomes like LGA, macrosomia, and SGA are related to birth weight classification)
gest_age: N/A (though gestational age was a variable for correction and preterm birth, LGA, SGA are related to gestational age)
